description: Build-up reel for Listing 11 (owner 10.11, reference: ds.nuvora reel): ONE room, ONE camera, layers appear one by one: b1 empty room, b2 the mural on the wall (the hook), b3 shelves with warm LED + mirror + sconce, b4 furniture, b5 rich decor. The FINAL frame b5 is generated first (two decor variants a/b); the earlier frames are made from it by removing one layer at a time (removing is more reliable than adding). The mural stays visible and nothing stands in front of it, the shelves are on the SIDE wall. Realistic, not cartoonish. py -3.12 -X utf8 scripts/buildup.py l11_buildup01

stages.prompt:
Create a photorealistic photograph of a warm, calm children's reading corner in a German apartment, with a low reading bench and warm oak, in Woodland Nature style (green, brown, beige and cream, solid wood and natural textiles).

References: image 1 is the wall mural. It covers the whole feature wall edge to edge, floor to ceiling, drawing and colours unchanged; the whole wall stays visible and nothing stands in front of it. Image 2 is a macro photo of the wallpaper paper: take only its fine sand-grain, matte surface, never its graphics.

Scene: A bright room with a warm oak floor and a large round natural jute rug on it. On the LEFT side wall, away from the mural: three slim floating solid-oak shelves one above the other, each with a thin warm-white LED strip (2700 K) hidden under its front edge that casts a soft, realistic warm glow down the wall, not neon. Top shelf: three picture books lying flat, a small white ceramic vase with dried pampas grass and one unlit cream pillar candle. Middle shelf: a trailing green pothos in a white ceramic pot and a small framed botanical print. Bottom shelf: two upright picture books and a small cream ceramic ring vase. A round brass-framed mirror hangs to the left of the shelves and above it a brass wall sconce with a frosted globe bulb glowing warmly. Below the shelves stands a low solid-oak reading bench (40 cm high) with one soft oat cushion. Beside it a round fluted-oak side table carries a glass vase with fresh cream ranunculus and sage-green eucalyptus. One tall green areca palm in a white pot stands in the far corner. A sheer cream linen curtain hangs at the extreme right edge of the frame, close to the camera and slightly out of focus. Palette: warm oak, oat, cream, soft sage and white with small brass accents. Only the items named in this scene are in the room: nothing is draped over any furniture, no baskets, no wicker, no toys, no lit candles, and the room is empty of people.

Light and camera: warm golden hour sunlight from a window on the LEFT lies in long soft patches across the floor. Shot from the right part of the room at natural eye level, turned about 30 degrees toward the mural wall and pulled well back, so the LEFT side wall is in view. The whole mural wall is in the frame in perspective, from its near edge to the far corner, with a strip of ceiling above it and the skirting board below it; the wall fills the upper-middle of the tall frame and the floor fills the lower part. Nothing stands in front of the mural. Canon EOS R5, 28mm lens, f/11 aperture, sharp across the whole wall. A real editorial interior photograph for a German home magazine, not a render and not an illustration: natural window light with soft falloff, true-to-life materials (visible wood grain, natural linen, matte painted surfaces, small signs of daily use), slightly muted natural colour, gentle contrast, fine film-like grain, no HDR glow, no plastic smoothness, no neon.
